## What
Create tests/scripts/test-consult-recipe-registry.sh defining the expected behavior of the consult-recipe-registry.sh helper before implementation.

## Why
TDD RED phase: tests must exist and fail before the implementation script exists.

## Acceptance Criteria
- test-consult-recipe-registry.sh exists and is executable
- Tests verify: (a) listing all recipes outputs name, language, scope, and capability_description for each entry in recipe-registry.yaml; (b) --language python filter returns only python recipes; (c) --language typescript filter returns only typescript recipes; (d) unknown language returns empty output (exit 0); (e) missing registry file exits non-zero with error message
- All tests FAIL before Task 2 is complete (script does not exist yet)

## File Impact
- CREATE: tests/scripts/test-consult-recipe-registry.sh
